about: The alleluia of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.nr: The celebrant intones Alleluia three times, raising his voice each time, and all repeat it after each intonation.

seg.tr: Alleluia. Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever. O praise the Lord, all ye nations; praise Him, all ye peoples. For His mercy is confirmed upon us, and the truth of the Lord remaineth for ever.
